title: Apple Pay is now available in India
description: Twelve years after first launching its payment service in the US, Apple has finally brought Apple Pay to India, although the service is currently limited to select bank cards. Apple Pay is available to users in India across Apple devices, except Mac, although support for macOS is confirmed to be coming soon. The payment service currently supports Visa and Mastercard credit cards issued by Axis Bank. Users can add their cards to Apple Wallet and use tap-to-pay at thousands of in-store merchants or make online payments. Apple Pay also supports NFC transactions. In an official press...

title: The Honor Life S3 is a 3.7" ebook reader that attaches to the back of your phone with magnets
description: Recently, there has been a trend of add-on displays that magnetically attach to the back of your phone. Normally, they are used as preview displays for the camera, but Honor is going another way – what if your phone could carry an ebook reader? The Honor Life S3 is a tiny reader – it has a 3.68” e-ink display with 259ppi pixel density. The whole thing measures 5.6mm thick and weighs 61g. title: Our Redmi Note 17 5G battery life and charging tests are ready
description: Xiaomi’s Redmi Note series still features a 4G model despite most of the world having transitioned to 5G. We have both the Redmi Note 17 5G and the 4G variant and ran battery and charging tests on them. In this post, we’ll focus on the 5G model and in the next one, we’ll see what the 4G one has to offer. title: British court renews an antitrust lawsuit involving Apple and Amazon
description: In 2023, Apple and Amazon were hit with a class action lawsuit over a 2018 agreement between the two companies that restricts third-party retailers from selling Apple and Beats products on Amazon. This means the two companies engage in antitrust practices that limit competition and ultimately raise prices for the consumers. This is not the first time Amazon and Apple have faced scrutiny over this particular deal. The two giants were already hit with similar cases in Germany, the USA, Spain and Italy.
